quotations.old_english: Scír burna biþ gedréfed: bróc biþ onwended.
quotations.english: the clear stream is disturbed: the brook is turned aside

quotations.old_english: He hine bibaðaþ in ðam burnan
quotations.english: he bathes himself in the stream

source_text: burna, an; m. A stream, bourn; torrens, latex :-- Burna oððe bróc latex, Wrt. Voc. 80, 69. Scír burna biþ gedréfed: bróc biþ onwended. the clear stream is disturbed: the brook is turned aside, Bt. Met. Fox 5, 37; Met. 5, 19. He hine bibaðaþ in ðam burnan he bathes himself in the stream, Exon. 57b; Th. 205, 3; Ph. 107. Burna latex, Wrt. Voc. 54, 21. v. burn, burne.
